name: social-short-form-writer
description: Claude Code plugin that converts blog posts into native Instagram + TikTok + Threads captions. Photo-mode focused (4:5 carousel for IG, 9:16 vertical for TikTok, text/4:5 carousel for Threads). Authors Bahasa Indonesia captions across all 3 platforms (Indonesian audience target), hashtag-rule-aware (IG 3-5, TikTok 5-8, Threads 0-3), hook-first formulas, anti-AI-slop. IG also authors optional text_only_caption variant for Facebook text-post cross-post reuse. Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume.
author: Ali Sadikin <ali.sadikincom85@gmail.com>
